latent-heat-sweat.label: Heat removed per gram of sweat evaporated
latent-heat-sweat.value: 2,426 J (about 2.4 kJ) per gram, only if it evaporates

energy-as-heat.label: Share of metabolic energy released as heat during exercise
energy-as-heat.value: more than 75% (gross efficiency in cycling is about 20%)

sweat-rate-range.label: Whole-body sweat rate of athletes
sweat-rate-range.value: typically about 0.5–2.0 L·h⁻¹; above 3.0 L·h⁻¹ is rare

sweat-sodium-range.label: Sweat sodium concentration
sweat-sodium-range.value: about 10–90 mmol·L⁻¹ local; about 10–70 mmol·L⁻¹ whole body
